notes.title: Huge Optimization / Bug fix patch
notes.content:
[h1]Optimization[/h1]
Hello everyone, we have been working on optimizing the game past couple weeks. We have made some huge improvements and the game size itself downgraded to 1.2gb ish from 5.2gb.
Hopefully this will increase the performance and iron out the occuring freezes.
We are curious about your feedback on the game performance after this patch, will keep optimizing wherever we can and improve the game further.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed multiple instances where gaining reward was not working properly and causing softlocks
[*] Rage power button not working after quit/continue even when theres enough rage - fixed.
[*] Golden dragon rage power bugs if you spam click it multiple times causing the target arrow to freeze and unable to continue to next fight- fixed
[*] Swaped lava tile/ char tile interaction with poison element as its intended
[*] Frost now properly erases tornado tile after interaction
[*] Fixed Rage Power button bugs in Mission-5 of Tutorial
[*] Silent Watch, Thousand Faces and Aethel's Reach regions doesn't display the Attack reward when hovering them on the map. Silent Watch still only gives +100 hp. Fixed
[*] Blue Dragon animations are fixed after evolving
[*] Forfeiting game no longer counts as a victory
[*] Added toxic tile tooltip in combat
[*] Rat now also counts as aspects victory achievement. 
[*] Quit/Continue breaking toxicity animation - fixed
[*] Tile effect chart only shows fire/earth/wind while on map stage (shows lightning properly during fights). - Now shows in combat too
[*] Talents that add cards to your starter hand replacing fireballs, do not replace any cards on different aspect other than red, and now add on top of your starting hand. Multiple instances can overlap
[*] Nightbinder riddle game tooltip fixed where it showed wrong number on failure.
[*] Gold Dragon Rage power target tile is fixed as intented
[*] Thunderbolt doesn't apply Lightning to tiles. - Fixed
[*] Lightning interaction panel icons fixed
[/list]

We are still working on some issues Blue Dragon is having, expecting a hotfix this week for him.

[h2]Balance[/h2]
[list]
[*] Puddles now turn into ice tile if frost is applied
[*] Frost Breath now gains 200 damage per active ice tile
[*] Kingdom Knights each gain 100 attack during Rat fight
[*] Black Whelps now also gain buffs from Earth and Fire apply on top of Dark apply
[/list]

notes.title: Balance Changes to new ACT Bosses/ Hotfixes
notes.content:
Hello everyone, here are the changes for today

[b][h1]Balance[/h1][/b]
[b][h2]Nerfs[/h2][/b]
[h3]The Armament[/h3]
[list]
[*] HP reduced from 1 Million to 850k
[*] Generators on death: Deal 10k damage to the Armament.
[*] Removed entire top row tiles. [i]Will adress visibility issues in future updates. Removing top row is both for balance(less nexus tiles to deal with) and helps remove some of the tiles that are directly behind the boss[/i]
[*] Arcane Protocol now grants [b]all[/b] 2000 attack, meaning your whelps aswell(was self only). His massive power core boost everything around him.

[i]Dev note: We did this change mainly to buff up whelps builds against the armament, as the more whelps you have the more attack you now gain in total.[/i]

[*] Primal Resonance is no longer an AOE attack but a single target attack to Dragon.

[i]Dev note: As whelps can not hit cleave or aoe as they are single target, whelps build had massive trouble dealing enough damage required, as other sources can hit up to x9 times. With the AOE removal, it should be easier to build up more whelps and have a meaningful race between who defeats who first[/i]
[/list]

[h3]The Nightbinder[/h3]
[list]
[*] Riddler's Game failure damage reduced from 3000 to 500. 

[i]Dev note: Instead of some suggestions to remove non elemental cards effect on the Riddler's game, we want to try and keep it as it is but nerf the damage heavily into it feeling like a small ticking damage slowly creeping up on and have a meaningful damage race, instead of you being destroyed if you keep failing. Let us know what you think[/i]

[*] Entropy now creates 3 void tiles instead of 5.
[/list]

[h3]Sohei[/h3]
[list]
[*] God-Slaying Fang now only requires 1 attack card to counter (was 2)
[*] HP reduced from 250k to 200k
[/list]

[b][h2]Buffs[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] "Prismatic Lance" card base damage increased to 1000. Does 300 more damage per meteor casted that fight(was 200)
[*] Breath of the Wyrmling now grants 200 attack(was 100)
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue with black shade over the UI on top right covering 3 buttons
[*] During Act IV, moves left until act fight UI was showing negative numbers > fixed
[*] SIlent Watch ( new territory) has some of its roads fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: None Shall Intrude - Resurgence is OUT! ACT IV & New Bosses Unlocked!
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone, our first Major Patch for None Shall Intrude: Resurgence is out![/b]

[h1][b]Act IV[/b][/h1]
Act IV offers 5 more map movements and 2 fully new unique Act fights.

[h1][b]New Act Fights[/b][/h1]
There is 5 new act fights(boss fights) added with the new update. 1 new alternative for Act I,II,III and 2 new fights for Act IV

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022282/505448a61a6021221d71033d140ab4d803ec26a3.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022282/016ea6b16829cd1c39b0912708fd66fef8e456fd.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022282/6099f3a84f462ef6a994f2393c0c923534518dea.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022282/69fce4ff98fe5f5e5318120b5b9193af0c104b8c.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022282/e4a2b071c9483d2f84dd9544f13e638524702dd0.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Trailer [/b][/h1]

[previewyoutube=GCJQIgLTAUI;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2][b]Armament 50[/b][/h2]
We added our final Armament Cap being 50. At 50 you can no longer heal after any raid or boss fights.

[h2][b]Conquer the whole Map[/b][/h2]
After defeating Act IV, players are now given 3 choices how to continue. First is to just go to victory screen. Second is to keep going (currently "Not enough" option) lets you keep conquering the entire map

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022282/716e63e2e9568ff617c2c08101acfe28f2bb215a.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]"Infinity Mode"[/b][/h2]
A third choice after beating ActIV, is now to start currently called newgame+. In this option you keep all your upgrades (HP, attack,cards,relics,talents..) from your run but the whole map resets with everything having x3 Attack x3 HP and a new Passive: Every enemy on death, deals damage equal to their attack. 

Currently this newgame+ can be repeated 4 times, where the scale goes: x3,x6,x9,x12
[h2][b]New Cards & Relics[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022282/ba6bd30113999429efb78e4b3fe4605192dcacf8.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022282/b4d5880168d310e1b4c7f003c37acec5a826365e.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Scores[/b][/h2]

We added a scoring system that calculate it according to How many Acts beaten, Armament level, and newgame+ level. We removed timer from previous scoring system. You can check your score in steam leaderboard, we will put one in game in future updates.

[h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]

Fixed issues where cards would duplicate in your draw piles, causing various issues.

We fixed many bugs since our release. You can check our hotfix updates if you would like to know more.

[h2][b]Next Major Patch[/b][/h2]
The long awaited...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022282/654fef7a850856e11a08bfd5e616f9b8ef15eb8b.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Beta and Date Announcement for Major Patch
notes.content:
Hello everyone our beta is live for the Upcoming Major patch. The patch itself will go live at [b]6th March!
[/b]
We would like for those who are interested to try out the beta and give us your feedback until the release.
[h3][b]Act IV[/b][/h3]
Act IV offers 5 more map movements and 2 fully new unique Act fights.

[h3][b]New Act Fights[/b][/h3]
There is 5 new act fights(boss fights) added with the new update. 1 new alternative for Act I,II,III and 2 new fights for Act IV

[i]Note: During beta for testing purposes we only included the new boss fights, actual release will ofcourse have old alternatives aswell.[/i]

[h3][b]Armament 50[/b][/h3]
We added our final Armament Cap being 50. At 50 you can no longer heal after any raid or boss fights.

[h3][b]Conquer the whole Map[/b][/h3]
After defeating Act IV, players are now given 3 choices how to continue. First is to just go to victory screen. Second is to keep going (currently "Not enough" option) lets you keep conquering the entire map

[h3][b]"Infinity Mode"[/b][/h3]
A third choice after beating ActIV, is now to start currently called newgame+. In this option you keep all your upgrades (HP, attack,cards,relics,talents..) from your run but the whole map resets with everything having x3 Attack x3 HP and a new passive: Every enemy on death, deals damage equal to their attack. 

Currently this newgame+ can be repeated 4 times, where the scale goes: x3,x6,x9,x12

On release, there will be a scoreboard, that will calculate your score on how many act boss you beat, on which armament and on which infinity world.

[h3][b]New Legendary Cards[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Cinders[/b]: Draw 3 cards and gain 3 AP. Ignite
[*][b]Legend In Flesh[/b]: Create 3 Pyro cards, they cost 0AP this turn (not available in beta yet)
[*][b]Prismatic Lance[/b]: Deal 500 damage. Deal 200 more for each Meteor casted this combat(not available in beta yet)
[*][b]Radiation[/b]: Deal 3000 damage for every Nuke on its way
[/list]
[h3][b]New Ultimate Cards[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Steel[/b]: Gain 15000 armor
[*] [b]Alpha[/b]: All whelps in combat gains +5000 max HP
[*] [b]Cacophony[/b]: Apply 20 random tiles Earth
[/list]
[h3][b]New Relics[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Ashen Talon[/b]: Every 0 AP cost card grants 100 attack after use rest of turn
[*] [b]Worldbreaker Shard[/b]: If you play 15 unique cards in a combat, gain 1000 attack
[*] [b]Breath of the Wyrmking[/b]: Exhaling 3 times in same turn grants 100 attack
[*] [b]Mad Bomber’s Crate[/b]: Firebomb explosion increase next Firebomb damage by 1000 this turn. This effect can stack
[*] [b]Steelheart[/b]: Start every fight with +100 armor
[*] [b]Draconic Codex[/b]: Combo grants 10 rage
[*] [b]Hellfire Fuses[/b]: If 4 firebomb explode in 1 turn, apply 5 fire and 5 earth randomly
[/list]


Here is how you can participate in the beta:

Right click on the game in the Library > Click Properties...

Go to Betas tab, then select "Beta" in the drop-list of beta programs.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//39309917/fa8c21cd7899f09b1ddbe76f8142ecdf622c0dad.png[/img]

Steam will automatically download the Beta version of the game. You can close it afterward.

After changing your Beta selection, you'll be asked to restart the Steam client.
If Steam does not automatically download, then you might need to restart Steam.

notes.title: Upcoming Major Content Patch Info
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we are reading every review and feedback carefully, as we are trying to fix our bugs we also hear you guys want more content, and we will deliver. We would like to announce that we are working on two content patches in a fast cadence. Heres the[b] Roadmap:[/b]

[h2]First Major Patch Content[/h2]
[list]
[*] Adding Act IV. Comes with 5 new map moves, 2 different ActIV Hero(boss) fights.
[*] Option to continue your run even after beating ActIV for those who want complete destruction of the entire map for fun.(no rewards or achievements for this). [i]Idea here is to disable any healing after raids, and every 5 move you make we will throw you a random ACT fight in the raids to keep things interesting still until you conquer the whole map[/i]
[*] ActI ActII and ActIII each get 1 alternative Hero(boss) fights. This way all 4 acts will have 2 alternative fights instead of current 1. So our total "ACT Hero fight" count will go from 3 to 8 with the patch.
[*] New Relics and curse cards.
[/list]
[h2]Second Major Patch Content[/h2]
[list]
[*] Adding Dragon Skins for Black, Golden and Blue dragon.
[*] Adding New Rage power to Black, Golden and Blue dragon.
[*] New legendary/ultimate cards.
[*] Adding Modifier runs. Idea for these is to alter the game mechanics greatly to try fun new things. 
Examples: 
-You no longer have a deck, you get a random 20 card deck at the start of each fight. 
-You draft a deck of 20 cards instead of normal starting deck
-Everytime you play a card, rest of all cards in hand AP cost either increase by 1 or decrease by 1AP
-All card rewards are legendary.
and more

We would like your feedback on three potential way to obtain the new Dragon Skins
-Option 1: You get the new skins and new rage powers automatically when patch is live
-Option 2: Modified runs reward a currency and you can then buy the new skins with those currencies.
-Option 3: New skins are auto added like in option 1 but the new rage powers have to be purchased from modified run currencies.
We are more inclined to do option 1 but we are interested in your thoughts, or maybe other options that come to your mind.
[/list]

Dates for Major patches will be announced in future.

Next Hotfix patch is tomorrow (wednesday 5th), will be adding card and relic codex to cave with this one.

notes.title: Hotfixes and New Armaments
notes.content:
[h2]New [/h2]
[list]
[*] Increased max Armament to 40
[*] "Forger's Bane" armament now has another level that gives 3 curse cards. 
[*] "Arcane Armory" armement now has another level that grants 2 Passives to heroes.
[*] Added new sound to Deathroll
[*] Added Armament 40 achievement

We will keep adding new Armaments to keep things challenging for those who seek it :) Next armament idea is to remove Heal after ACTI and then from every ACT entirely.

[h2]Announcement[/h2]
[list]
We will be making an announcement soon about upcoming Major Content patches! We have heard your feedback that the game feels short and lacks enemy variety. Our first content patch will introduce Act 4 along with new variety fights for Acts 1, 2, and 3. Stay tuned for more details in the official announcement![/list]

notes.title: Balance and Language Patch
notes.content:
Hello everyone, our first patch is out. Here are the changes:

[h3][b]Balance[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Turn Timer has been removed from the default game. 
Turn Timer will be added later in the full version of the game as one of the options you can choose from when increasing difficulty. 

[i]We decided to keep the option to enable Turn Timer and added it as a toggle in the options menu for now. It will be removed from the options menu once we add difficulty settings in the full game.
[/i]
[*] Wave 2 enemies have been changed to have easier heroes.
[*] Starting MaxHP increased to 150.
[*] Phase2 now starts at 65% HP (was 50%) and Phase3 now starts at 30% HP (was 25%)
[*] Heroism no longer activates if the enemy hero is already beaten.
[*] Cabal Reliquary: Now grants +1/2/3 fireball damage in Phase 1,2 and 3, respectively. ( was +2 dmg Phase1 only)
[*] Otan Canon: Now grants 1/2/4 firebombs in Phase 1,2 and 3 respectively (was 2 firebomb every Phase)
[/list]
[h3][b]Music[/b][/h3]
[list]
6 new pieces of music have been added.
[/list]
[h3][b]Animation[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Whelps buff animation has been added.
[*] Whelps merge animation has been added.
[/list]
[h3][b]Language Support[/b][/h3]
We added the following languages:
[list]
[*] Chinese
[*] Czech
[*] French
[*] German
[*] Italian
[*] Japanese
[*] Polish
[*] Portuguese
[*] Russian
[*] Spanish
[*] Thai
[*] Turkish
[*] Ukranian
[*] Vietnamese
[*] Romanian
[/list]
